name: 34212 · Bradenton, FL
findings: ZIP 34212 (Bradenton) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34212 (Bradenton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
